verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a dedicated `pulumi preview` command that shows planned updates to a stack's resources without making any changes ([pulumi-docs-8], [pulumi-docs-19]). Its docs also describe a preview-then-deploy workflow ([pulumi-docs-67]), and `--import-file` can list every resource the program would create ([pulumi-docs-21]). missing for 10: explicit documentation that preview breaks changes down into creates, updates and destroys, evidence of property-level diff detail ("exactly what will change"), and independent or hands-on corroboration of preview accuracy.
